race.comment: ALDEBARAN MIGUEL (1) is back from a break of nine weeks and looks to be right up to the mark following a placing in a recent trial. Sure to enjoy an economical run from this draw. Well-placed to take this out. NORTHERN SKYE (2) enjoys a class drop on a sixth at her most recent appearance at Geelong. Placed in the prior outing and draws well. PETITE FOUR (3) broke last start and finished 6 metres from the winner in fourth over 2195m at Ararat. That followed a fourth to commence her career. Draws well so can feature with manners. CHAMPAGNESALLY (5) is back from a let-up but has trialled. Go well.
